title: SEC6/decision: insert_if_allowed closure hoisted because TypeFilter is Copy
description: In crates/kithd/src/events.rs, the insert_if_allowed closure (lines 263-271) is defined once outside the event loop rather than inside it. The justification is that TypeFilter is a Copy type (a single u8 bitmask), so the closure captures it by copy. If type_filter were a non-Copy type (e.g., Vec<String>), defining the closure inside the loop body would move the value on the first iteration, causing a compile error or forcing a clone each iteration. By making TypeFilter: Copy and hoisting the closure, the code avoids per-iteration allocation and keeps the filter logic at a single definition site. The comment at line 261-262 documents this rationale in-source.
